name: local-ai-council
description: Local-first multi-agent council that asks multiple local AI CLIs, runs optional calibration rounds, synthesizes a final answer, and saves audit trails.

default_parameters.question: What should this project improve next?

safety.network: Local GUI binds to 127.0.0.1 by default.
safety.execution: Agent commands come from local agents.yaml and run as argument arrays without shell=True.
safety.privacy: Run outputs and memory may contain private prompts; do not publish runs/ or council_memory/.

agent_instructions: Run ./bootstrap first on a fresh clone.
Run ./check before and after modifying code.
Run ./ai-council doctor to validate real configured AI CLIs.
Use ./ai-council '<question>' --rounds 2 --final-only for a non-interactive final answer.
Use ./gui for the local browser UI.
Never commit agents.yaml, runs/, council_memory/, .env files, or generated artifacts.
